conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Shalini Tiwari. Mera credit card ka PIN kaise change karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Shalini ji, main aapko guide karta hoon. Kya aap apna card number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai. Aap hamare mobile app ya ATM se PIN change kar sakti hain. Main aapko app ke steps SMS karta hoon. Kya yeh theek hai?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, SMS bhej do. Kitna time lagega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Turant reflect ho jayega jaise hi aap new PIN set karengi. Koi aur madad?
